name: proto-two-files-not-read-cleanly-for-causes-of-their-own
description: With no buf.yaml and no proto.import_paths, one file whose import no root resolves and another that fails over a duplicate field number each publish nothing, the first with an unresolved-import note and the second with a schema-unparsed note. Since a schema file not read cleanly may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
